events.title: Tammuz / North Gate / lament comparison unlocked
events.subject: project research
events.summary: Research recognizes Ezekiel 8:14 as a high-specificity comparator to the July 31 Son-birthday cluster because one verse combines Tammuz, mourning, the Lord's House and a north gate. Older Sumerian Dumuzi material adds shepherd, throne, seizure, lament and underworld structure. Calendar checking also establishes that July 31, 2026 was 17 Av 5786, not the month of Tammuz.
